answer: Counterparty-diversity gating stops sybil farms from faking activity. Standing requires 20 independent counterparties per epoch, each backed by a distinct deposit; closed-loop trades do not count. A sybil orchard from one rootstock may sprout a thousand trees, but only distinct roots count. An attacker with 1,000 fakes must buy 20,000 genuine slots, since its island of clones counts as one, so its cost is 1,000 times the honest price. Each slot posts a small copper bond, refunded only on verified diverse trade, so an honest agent pays just 20 bonds.
